name: @lotwhite/model-context-protocol

tools.name: generateImageUrl
tools.description: Generate an image URL from a text prompt. Returns a shareable/embeddable URL without downloading the image. Supports all image models and parameters including image-to-image with the 'image' parameter.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate (required)

model.description: Image model to use. Options: flux (default, fast), turbo (ultra-fast), gptimage (OpenAI), kontext (context-aware, supports i2i), seedream/seedream-pro (high quality, supports i2i), nanobanana/nanobanana-pro (Gemini-based), zimage (experimental). Use listImageModels for full list.

width.description: Image width in pixels (default: 1024). Common sizes: 512, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536, 2048

height.description: Image height in pixels (default: 1024). Common sizes: 512, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536, 2048

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible results (default: 42). Use same seed + prompt for identical images

enhance.description: Let AI improve your prompt for better results (default: false). Adds detail and style suggestions

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid in the image (default: 'worst quality, blurry'). Example: 'blurry, low quality, text, watermark'

guidance_scale.description: How closely to follow the prompt (1-20). Higher = more literal, lower = more creative. Default varies by model

quality.description: Image quality level (default: 'medium'). 'hd' for maximum quality, 'low' for faster generation

image.description:
Reference image URL(s) for image-to-image generation. Separate multiple URLs with | or comma.
I2I models: seedream-pro, nanobanana-pro, nanobanana, gptimage, seedream (all multi-image), kontext (single image).
Put this parameter last in URL or URL-encode it.

transparent.description: Generate with transparent background (default: false). Useful for logos, stickers, overlays

nologo.description: Remove Pollinations watermark from image (default: false)

nofeed.description: Don't add image to public feed (default: false)

safe.description: Enable safety content filters (default: false). Blocks NSFW content

private.description: Hide image from public feeds/gallery (default: false)

tools.name: generateImage
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt and return the base64-encoded image data. Full control over all generation parameters. Supports image-to-image with kontext, seedream, nanobanana models.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate (required)

model.description: Image model to use. Options: flux (default, fast), turbo (ultra-fast), gptimage (OpenAI), kontext (context-aware, supports i2i), seedream/seedream-pro (high quality, supports i2i), nanobanana/nanobanana-pro (Gemini-based), zimage (experimental). seed.description: Random seed for reproducible results (default: 42). Use same seed + prompt for identical images

enhance.description: Let AI improve your prompt for better results (default: false). Adds detail and style suggestions

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid in the image (default: 'worst quality, blurry'). Example: 'blurry, low quality, text, watermark'

guidance_scale.description: How closely to follow the prompt (1-20). Higher = more literal, lower = more creative. Default varies by model

quality.description: Image quality level (default: 'medium'). 'hd' for maximum quality, 'low' for faster generation

image.description:

tools.name: generateImageBatch
tools.description: Generate multiple images in parallel (up to 10). Best with sk_ keys (no rate limits). pk_ keys will be rate-limited. Each prompt generates one image with shared parameters.

prompts.description: Array of prompts to generate images for (1-10 prompts). Each prompt generates one image.

tools.name: generateVideo
tools.description: Generate a video from a text prompt or image. Models: veo (text-to-video, 4-8s, audio), seedance (text/image-to-video, 2-10s), seedance-pro (best quality). Use 'image' parameter with seedance models for image-to-video generation.

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate (required)

model.description:
Video model (default: 'veo'):
- veo: Google's model, text/image-to-video, 4/6/8 sec, supports audio, single image input
- seedance: ByteDance, text/image-to-video, 2-10 sec, multi-image support
- seedance-pro: ByteDance Pro, text/image-to-video, 2-10 sec, multi-image, best prompt adherence

duration.description:
Video duration in seconds:
- veo: 4, 6, or 8 seconds only
- seedance/seedance-pro: 2-10 seconds

audio.description: Enable audio generation (default: false). Only supported by veo model

image.description: Reference image URL(s) for image-to-video generation. veo: single image only. seedance/seedance-pro: multi-image (separate with | or comma).

nofeed.description: Don't add to public feed (default: false)

tools.name: generateVideoUrl
tools.description: Generate a video URL from a text prompt. Returns a shareable/embeddable URL without downloading the video. Models: veo (4-8s, audio), seedance (2-10s), seedance-pro (best quality).

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate (required)

model.description:
Video model (default: 'veo'):
- veo: Google's model, text/image-to-video, 4/6/8 sec, supports audio, single image input
- seedance: ByteDance, text/image-to-video, 2-10 sec, multi-image support
- seedance-pro: ByteDance Pro, text/image-to-video, 2-10 sec, multi-image, best prompt adherence

duration.description:
Video duration in seconds:
- veo: 4, 6, or 8 seconds only
- seedance/seedance-pro: 2-10 seconds

audio.description: Enable audio generation (default: false). Only supported by veo model

image.description: Reference image URL(s) for image-to-video generation. veo: single image only. seedance/seedance-pro: multi-image (separate with | or comma).

nofeed.description: Don't add to public feed (default: false)

tools.name: describeImage
tools.description: Analyze and describe an image using vision-capable AI models. Pass an image URL and optionally a custom prompt. Great for image captioning, content analysis, OCR, and visual Q&A.

imageUrl.description: URL of the image to analyze (required)

prompt.description: What to analyze about the image (default: 'Describe this image in detail.'). Examples: 'What text is in this image?', 'What emotions are shown?', 'List all objects'

model.description: Vision-capable model to use (default: 'openai'). Options: openai, gemini, claude, grok - all support vision

tools.name: analyzeVideo
tools.description: Analyze a video using AI. Supports YouTube URLs and direct video links. Uses gemini-large for native video understanding (frames + audio). Great for video summarization, content analysis, and Q&A about videos.

videoUrl.description: URL of the video to analyze. Supports YouTube URLs (youtube.com, youtu.be), direct video URLs (https://...), and Google Cloud Storage (gs://...)

prompt.description: What to analyze about the video (default: 'Describe what happens in this video'). Examples: 'Summarize the key points', 'What is being discussed?', 'List all people shown'

model.description: Model to use (default: 'gemini-large'). gemini-large and gemini support native video input

tools.name: listImageModels
tools.description: List all available image and video generation models with their capabilities. Shows which models support image-to-image, video generation, and other features. Models are fetched dynamically from the API.

refresh.description: Force refresh the model cache (default: false)

tools.name: generateText
tools.description: Generate text from a simple prompt. Easy-to-use text generation with essential parameters. For advanced features (tool calling, multi-turn, audio), use chatCompletion instead.

prompt.description: Text prompt to generate a response for (required)

model.description:
Text model to use (default: 'openai'). Popular options:
- openai/openai-fast/openai-large: GPT models (balanced/fast/powerful)
- claude/claude-fast/claude-large: Anthropic Claude models
- gemini/gemini-fast/gemini-large: Google Gemini models
- deepseek: Advanced reasoning model
- grok: xAI's Grok model
- mistral, qwen-coder, perplexity-fast, perplexity-reasoning
Use listTextModels for complete list.

system.description: System prompt to set context/behavior. Example: 'You are a helpful coding assistant'

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate. Leave empty for model default

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling (default: 1). Alternative to temperature. Use one or the other

frequency_penalty.description: Reduce repetition of token sequences (-2 to 2, default: 0)

presence_penalty.description: Reduce repetition of topics (-2 to 2, default: 0)

json.description: Return response in JSON format (default: false). Model will output valid JSON

tools.name: chatCompletion
tools.description:
OpenAI-compatible chat completions with ALL parameters. Supports:
- Multi-turn conversations with message history
- Function/tool calling for AI agents
- Audio input/output (openai-audio model)
- Reasoning mode (kimi-k2-thinking, perplexity-reasoning, openai-large, gemini-large)
- JSON/structured output
- Built-in Gemini tools (google_search, code_execution, etc.)
- Perplexity web search with citations

role.description: Message role: system (set behavior), user (your input), assistant (AI response), tool (tool result)

content.description: Message content. String for text, or array for multimodal (images, audio, video)

tool_call_id.description: Tool call ID (required for tool role messages)

tool_calls.description: Tool calls from assistant (for continuing tool use)

messages.description: Array of messages in the conversation. Include system message first to set behavior

model.description: Text model (default: 'openai'). See listTextModels for all options

temperature.description: Creativity level (0-2, default: 1). Lower = more focused, higher = more creative

stop.description: Stop sequences. Generation stops when these are encountered. Max 4 sequences

json_schema.description: JSON schema for structured output (when type='json_schema')

response_format.description: Response format. Use 'json_object' for JSON output, 'json_schema' for structured data

thinking.description: Thinking mode for reasoning models. Use with kimi-k2-thinking, perplexity-reasoning, openai-large, gemini-large

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort level. Works with reasoning models like kimi-k2-thinking, openai-large

type.description: Tool type. 'function' for custom functions, others are Gemini built-in tools

tools.description: Tools available to the model. For function calling or Gemini built-in tools

tool_choice.description: How to handle tools: 'none' (don't use), 'auto' (model decides), 'required' (must use), or specific function

function_call.description: Legacy function call option (deprecated, use 'tool_choice' instead)

modalities.description: Output modalities. Include 'audio' for voice output (openai-audio model)

audio.description: Audio output options. Requires modalities to include 'audio'

logprobs.description: Return log probabilities of tokens (default: false)

top_logprobs.description: Number of top logprobs to return (0-20)

logit_bias.description: Token ID to bias mapping. Adjust likelihood of specific tokens

user.description: Unique user identifier for tracking/abuse prevention

tools.name: listTextModels
tools.description: List all available text generation models with their capabilities. Shows which models support reasoning, tools, audio, vision, etc. Models are fetched dynamically from the API.

refresh.description: Force refresh the model cache (default: false)

tools.name: webSearch
tools.description: Search the web for real-time information using search-enabled models. Returns answers with source citations. Great for current events, facts, research.

model.description:
Search model (default: 'perplexity-fast'):
- perplexity-fast: Quick answers with web search
- perplexity-reasoning: Deeper analysis with web search
- gemini-search: Google's Gemini with Google Search

detailed.description: Get comprehensive answer with more details (default: false)

tools.name: getPricing
tools.description: Get pricing information for all models. Shows cost per token/image in pollen.

type.description: Which models to get pricing for (default: 'all')

tools.name: respondAudio
tools.description: Generate an audio response to a text prompt. The AI will respond to your prompt with speech.

prompt.description: The text prompt to respond to with audio

voiceInstructions.description: Additional instructions for voice style (e.g., 'Speak with enthusiasm')

tools.name: sayText
tools.description: Generate speech that says the provided text verbatim. Direct text-to-speech.

tools.name: listAudioVoices
tools.description: List all available audio voices and supported formats. Voices are fetched dynamically from the API.

tools.name: transcribeAudio
tools.description: Transcribe audio from a URL. Uses gemini-large for accurate speech-to-text transcription.

audioUrl.description: URL of the audio file to transcribe

prompt.description: Custom transcription instructions (default: 'Transcribe this audio accurately')

model.description: Model to use (default: 'gemini-large'). Also supports: gemini, openai-audio

tools.name: setApiKey
tools.description: Set your pollinations.ai API key for authenticated requests. Get your key at https://enter.pollinations.ai

key.description: Your API key (pk_ for publishable, sk_ for secret)

tools.name: getKeyInfo
tools.description: Get information about the currently set API key

tools.description: Clear the stored API key
